description: Get the current (or dated) text of a Code of Federal Regulations citation such as "49 CFR 395.3(a)(2)" or "29 CFR 1910.147(c)(4)" from the official eCFR, paragraph by paragraph with a citation and link for each.

citation.description: A section citation with a title, e.g. 49 CFR 192.605(b)

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD to read the rule as of that date (optional)

name: cfr_lookup
title: Read a federal regulation (eCFR)
